MEMB.description: Define Member (MEMB). Groups frame elements into structural members; fields are driven by the assign mode (AUTO vs MANUAL) and how the target elements are selected.

Argument.description: Request body that controls how members are defined from frame elements.

ELEM_LIST.description: Element list to define members from. When provided (manual selection), members are built only from these elements; ignored when ASSIGN_TYPE=AUTO and SELECTION_TYPE=ALL, where all model elements are used. Only frame-type elements are considered.

ASSIGN_TYPE.description: How members are formed from the selected frame elements (case-insensitive). MANUAL: group the given elements into members; AUTO: automatically detect members. MANUAL combined with SELECTION_TYPE=ALL is rejected.

SELECTION_TYPE.description: Element selection scope (case-insensitive). ALL: use all elements in the model; SELECTION: use the elements in ELEM_LIST. MANUAL + ALL is not allowed.

ALLOW_SINGLE.description: Whether a member may consist of a single element.
